frontend.app.hero_title: Turn control goals into verifiable results.
frontend.app.hero_description: Start with task boundaries, build a solution from evidence, and verify it through independent trials. Every step is recorded.
frontend.app.my_equipment_help: Define goals, measured signals, and software trial boundaries, then complete what you know step by step.
frontend.app.built_in_cases_help: Start with a heater or motor case to see how evidence, controllers, and evaluation connect.
frontend.app.case_help: Engineering cases show the full workflow; audit cases explain boundaries and rejection reasons.
frontend.app.footer: CFDC Kernel · Traceable evidence and software evaluation
frontend.datacurves.empty: No accepted data curves for the current protocol yet.
frontend.datacurves.title: Accepted experimental data
frontend.datacurves.help: Only data accepted under the current protocol is shown. Zooming reloads a display sample from the complete record for the selected time window.
frontend.expert.artifact_help: Load one level and page at a time; download to preserve the complete original record.
frontend.expert.timeline: Task → Diagnosis → Evidence → Route / Features → Controller → Freeze → Evaluation → Tuning / Confirmation → Result
frontend.expert.valid_artifact: Artifact contract is valid; validation does not grant permission to execute.
frontend.expert.title: Expert tools
frontend.expert.import_help: Confirm task boundaries again after import. Case execution permissions and knowledge base bindings are not inherited.
frontend.externalworkflow.offline_only: . Used only for offline software evaluation. This task does not operate hardware.
frontend.externalworkflow.recovery_title: Current evidence must be collected again
frontend.externalworkflow.recovery_help: Create a new task below and collect data under the new protocol. Original records are preserved.
frontend.externalworkflow.source_help: Select the data source actually used for this task. This records the evidence source; it does not select an execution tool. Run trials outside the application using your own simulation environment or experimental facilities, then return here to upload the data. Preserve the source and protocol identifiers in every run record.
frontend.externalworkflow.freeze_title: Evaluate against the same agreement after freezing
frontend.externalworkflow.freeze_help: Review the reference target, region, sampling interval, duration, repeats, performance requirements, and applicable phase transitions and disturbance settings in the task sidebar.
frontend.externalworkflow.freeze_confirm: I have reviewed the frozen agreement and confirm development evaluation
frontend.externalworkflow.resume_help: Continue processing the saved results. No need to upload trajectories again.
frontend.externalworkflow.download_help: The request bundle does not contain completed trial results. Run every trajectory in your external environment following the manifest, and fill the templates with complete time series, inputs and outputs, run identifiers, and stop records. Downloading does not advance the task.
frontend.externalworkflow.fresh_help: Run again using this confirmation bundle. Do not reuse development evaluation or tuning data.
frontend.externalworkflow.run_step: Step 2 · Run externally and package the results
frontend.externalworkflow.run_help: In your own runtime, apply the candidate controller, inputs, and stop conditions in this run manifest and save complete records for every trial. Place the completed trial JSON files and original manifest.json at the root of the results ZIP. Do not return the request bundle or submit only summary metrics. Keep columns and units consistent with this request. Trials run outside the application; this page manages requests, data, and evaluation and does not execute your environment.
frontend.externalworkflow.upload_step: Step 3 · Return here to upload and validate results
frontend.externalworkflow.upload_help: Next, the system checks all files and protocol bindings, computes evaluation results, and records rejection reasons. If any trial in an evaluation ZIP fails validation, the entire bundle is rejected. Follow the receipt and upload the complete results ZIP again. Accepted results advance to tuning, fresh independent confirmation, or the final report according to the current stage. No feature or controller JSON is required.
frontend.externalworkflow.submit_results: Validate and submit this run's trajectories
frontend.externalworkflow.repeats_prefix: %. Development evaluation and independent confirmation use the frozen agreement with
frontend.externalworkflow.tuning_help: repeats. Each candidate uses a separate run bundle, and independent confirmation needs fresh trajectories. The system records performance, failure reasons, and remaining budget before deciding the next step.
frontend.externalworkflow.restart_help: Collecting again creates a new task. The current task, its evidence, failure reasons, and audit records are preserved.
frontend.externalworkflow.restart: Collect again and create a new task
frontend.manualrequirements.file_count: Return {count} trial files for this run
frontend.manualrequirements.format_help: . Keep the filenames, columns, and units specified in the request bundle.

frontend.results.next_success: Export this software validation record. Create a new task to verify other goals or boundaries.
frontend.results.next_gap: Use this record to add evidence or redefine goals and boundaries in a new task.
frontend.results.next_cancelled: Export existing records and create a new task as needed.
frontend.results.next_default: Review the recorded results and continue from the current step.

frontend.reviewdetails.failure_retries: Maximum retries for the same failure
frontend.reviewdetails.stop_explanation: Stop or mark a boundary violation when the absolute value of any checked measurement exceeds this threshold. This is not deviation from the target or a hardware emergency stop.
frontend.reviewdetails.execution_help: Run the protocol in your own environment; download requests, upload data, and view results on the task page
frontend.reviewdetails.applied_defaults: Applied budgets (unspecified values use Kernel defaults)
frontend.reviewdetails.shared_input_help: The input range applies to all declared control inputs.
frontend.reviewdetails.disturbance_summa: Channel {channel}; start {start} s; amplitude {amplitude}; duration {duration} s

frontend.settings.environment_failed: Could not read environment configuration. Current values are preserved.
frontend.settings.providers_help: Ollama, DeepSeek API, and OpenAI API can be configured. An explicit test confirms connection status.
frontend.settings.credentials_help: Credentials stay only in this page's memory. Enter them again after refreshing.
frontend.settings.use_rag: Use built-in knowledge base for new tasks
frontend.settings.configuration_help: This configuration is used for model requests on the current page and does not need to be saved separately. Test the connection below.
frontend.settings.environment_help: Read the URL and model from the launch environment variables CFDC_LLM_BASE_URL and CFDC_LLM_MODEL. Missing values leave the form unchanged; the API Key is always preserved.
frontend.settings.import_environment: Import URL and model from launch environment
frontend.wizard.allowed_error: Allowed deviation from target after settling
frontend.wizard.restored_review: Review the restored draft again. Return to the boundaries page to validate it.
frontend.wizard.case_locked_help: Cases run with their original task contract. Copy the case into your own task before editing.
frontend.wizard.custom_title: Manage your control task in the browser
frontend.wizard.custom_help: Enter the goal, signals, and boundaries, review them, then answer diagnostic questions. The system provides an acquisition protocol, checklist, and data templates. Run trials outside the application in your own environment and upload results on the task page. The system computes features, builds a solution, and guides freezing, evaluation, tuning, and independent confirmation. No handwritten feature or controller JSON is needed.
frontend.wizard.description_placeholder: Describe the equipment, measurable quantities, and your goal
frontend.wizard.input_bounds_help: The input minimum and maximum apply to all declared control inputs.
frontend.wizard.evaluation_help: These settings generate the complete run manifest after task confirmation. External data must cover every repeated run and all inputs and outputs.
frontend.wizard.confirm_boundaries: I have reviewed the goal, software trial boundaries, and budgets
frontend.workspace.logger_checked: The logger can save all trial data
frontend.workspace.confirm_boundaries: I have reviewed the software trial boundaries and budgets
frontend.workspace.operator_purpose: Purpose: confirm you can record valid evidence under the acquisition protocol. Download and read the acquisition request bundle, and check the inputs, duration, sampling requirements, file templates, and stop rules for every trial.
frontend.workspace.operator_help: Check each condition below and record your conclusion. If unsure, select “Needs clarification” and explain what is missing. After submitting the check, run the acquisition in your own environment, then return to upload data. This confirmation only records workflow readiness and does not authorize hardware operation.
frontend.workspace.download_step: 1 · Download and review this task's acquisition requirements
frontend.workspace.acquisition_purpose: Purpose: provide raw evidence that supports the control solution. The request bundle contains the protocol, trial list, and data templates to fill in. Downloading does not collect data. Prepare records using the filenames, columns, units, and repeats below.
frontend.workspace.run_step: 2 · Run acquisition in your external environment
frontend.workspace.run_help: Trials run outside the application. In your own simulation environment or experimental facilities, set the initial conditions, inputs, and sampling intervals according to the protocol, and record inputs and outputs at every time point. Stop externally as soon as a limit is reached and preserve the stop record honestly. Do not fabricate, overwrite, or alter rejected evidence.
frontend.workspace.upload_step: 3 · Return here to upload and submit for validation
frontend.workspace.upload_help: Fill the request templates with actual records, preserving filenames and protocol identifiers. Upload result files or a results ZIP in the required format below. Do not upload blank templates. Accepted trials are preserved; supply missing files according to the receipt. After selecting local files, click the submit button below.
frontend.workspace.after_upload: Next: the system validates raw data, extracts features, and synthesizes and reviews candidate controllers. You do not need to submit feature or controller JSON. Accepted evidence advances to confirmation of the frozen evaluation agreement; otherwise this page shows the reasons and available next steps.
frontend.workspace.stopped: A trial limit was reached and the trial was stopped
frontend.workspace.reply_placeholder: Describe what you observed. You may say you do not know when information is unavailable.
frontend.workspace.unknown_reply: {previous}{newline}I do not know or have not measured this yet.
frontend.workspace.unknown: I do not know / have not measured
frontend.workspace.bounded_help: Each click runs only the current bounded tuning step. The Kernel determines the next stage.

frontend.workspace.active_operation_help: Waiting for the persisted operation to finish.

frontend.operations.expired: The operation record has expired. Check the task's current state before trying again. Your draft is preserved and will not be replayed automatically.
frontend.operations.recovery_help: Operation tracking can be restored after refreshing. Operations are not replayed automatically.

frontend.safety.legacy_draft: A draft containing legacy experiment configuration was not restored. Create a new task from the first step. The original draft is preserved until you edit the new task.
frontend.api.request_failed: Request failed. Check your input and try again.
frontend.api.stale_revision: Task records have changed. Refreshing the current step.
